integrity: The proof is analytic for every finite bipartition and every nonzero real or complex Hilbert space. The finite checker provides exact rational witness comparisons and separate floating-point complex examples.
limitations: The zero Hilbert space has a vacuous inequality for all sizes. Amplified best constants, arbitrary weighted or normalized-degree graphs, and other spatial exponents are outside the theorem.
title: The exact \(L^4\) heat square-function contraction boundary on complete bipartite graphs
